children: Office Properties Income Trust issued $425.0 million of 8.75% senior secured notes due 2031 and used the proceeds, along with cash on hand, to repay and terminate its secured revolving credit facility and secured term loan. The notes are guaranteed by certain subsidiaries and secured by first-priority liens on 19 office properties and related equity interests, with interest payable semi-annually. The refinancing simplifies the capital structure and extends maturities.
: U.S. Bank Trust Company, as trustee and collateral agent
: Refinance and repay secured credit facilities
: Secured revolving credit facility and secured term loan
: Wilmington Savings Fund Society, FSB, as Administrative Agent, and other lenders
: Repaid with proceeds from new notes and cash on hand
